notes: GHSA-6365-7ppr-5r92 is promoted at the SetVar that publishes the dial info through the request vars map (reverseproxy.go:663-666, line granularity): GetDialInfo reads the same mutable map at dial time, so a forward_auth handler can redirect the reverse_proxy transport to the auth upstream, which then serves proxy requests from a pooled connection. The 2.11.5 fix 1830809afe replaces it with a private context key.

CVE-2026-2950 is promoted at baseUnset (lodash.js:4371-4414): the CVE-2025-13465 guard skips non-string segments, castPath passes arrays through and baseGet/toKey stringifies them, so array-wrapped constructor/prototype segments delete built-in prototype properties. Fixed in 4.18.1 by fe8d32ed.

express CVE-2024-51999 is confirmed_not_affected: the advisory is withdrawn as a correctness bug and the 4.x patch was reverted upstream; rails CVE-2024-26143 is confirmed_not_affected: the published rows stop at 7.0.8.1 / 7.1.3.1 and 8.0.4 carries the escaping fix; gitea CVE-2026-96580 is out_of_scope: the workflow parser lives in the pinned gitea.com/gitea/act module.
